firstContext: You settle into the cold ground. Sleep takes you.
You catch fragments by the fire — Pilar telling Greta about Abigail. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
Ava won't meet your eye. You said you'd help with the pantry run — and it never happened. Promises rot. (-15 trust)
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
